Attached is the draft H1 2027 roadmap for leadership review ahead of Thursday's offsite. Headlines:

1. Usage-based pricing for the Team plan replaces per-seat pricing from 1 March 2027. Modelled impact: +11% net revenue retention, -3% logo retention in the first two quarters.
2. The on-prem edition is sunset at the end of H1; the 14 remaining on-prem customers get a migration credit.
3. Two acquisitions are under evaluation (codenames HERON and LARCH). Please do not discuss them outside this group.
4. Headcount plan: +18 in engineering, +6 in support, a hiring freeze in marketing.
